questions.prompt: The Normandy landings of June 1944 are better known by what name?
questions.fact: The D simply stands for day, a routine military placeholder for the start date of any operation.

questions.prompt: Which planet is known for being the hottest in the solar system?
questions.fact: Venus is hotter than Mercury despite being further from the Sun: a runaway greenhouse effect holds the surface at around 460C.

questions.prompt: Which trophy is contested annually by rugby union teams of Britain, Ireland, France and Italy?
questions.fact: A team beating all five opponents wins the Grand Slam; beating the other home nations wins the Triple Crown.

questions.prompt: Which 1993 film features dinosaurs cloned from preserved DNA?
questions.fact: Much of its most celebrated creature work is practical animatronics rather than computer animation.

questions.prompt: Which country is home to Machu Picchu?
questions.fact: It was never found by the Spanish, which is why it survived largely intact.

questions.prompt: Which novel features the character Ebenezer Scrooge?
questions.fact: The book helped popularise the phrase Merry Christmas and much of the modern shape of the holiday.
The format came from early mailing lists, where the same newcomer questions were asked repeatedly.
